question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**had**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context tells us that the leaves of the bananas were shiny and bright green, and the grass had started to emerge.
 
• The appropriate verb should indicate a **past perfect action** that was completed before another past event.
 
• The past perfect tense **"had begun"** correctly indicates that the growth of grass started before the present moment in the narrative.
 
• Other options ("**was**", "**will**", "**is**") do not fit the context of describing a sequence of past events.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *One day we saw Kala Nag. The monsoons had burst with all their fury, and it had rained in the night. The earth, which had lain parched and dry under the withering heat of the summer sun, was teeming **with **__life. In little pools, frogs croaked. The muddy ground was littered with __**crawling **__worms, centipedes and velvety lady-birds. Grass __**had **__begun to show and the banana leaves glistened bright and glossy green. The 4______ had flooded Kala Nag's hole. He sat in an open patch on the lawn. His shiny black hood glistened in the sunlight. He was big, almost six feet in 5______ and rounded and fleshy, as my wrist. "Looks like a King Cobra. Let's get him."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Was:** "Was" indicates a past action.
 
• **Will:** "Will" indicates a future action.
 
• **Is:** "Is" indicates a present action.
